tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
✨ Ability gained: Long Table (L1). Share food with everyone in camp to reduce their hunger. Costs 300 kcal; once a day.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Ruth.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Ben.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
🥣 Elena of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
Elena waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Thiago's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
(The pods need an answer. Speak for them — it will cost you — or let the segment play.)
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Ben of The Red Table II with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
🌙 You weren't at the treeline. Ben of The Red Table II didn't wait — they hit the stores and melted back into the dark with 800 kcal. The village will talk about this for a long time.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Grace speaks at Ashford's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You give Ashford 1,979 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Sam weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)

🧳 Word from The Red Table II: Andre is dead, and Zoe and Victor both claim the fire. The Red Table II is choosing — or fighting.
Elena waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. Not yet. The table is being set for those whose deeds are done, and yours are not done. The ledger still wants: a regional standing. The climb is not over.
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.
🗣️ David to Yuki, by the fire: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~1650 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
